hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals are visible, creating a barrier for pedestrian connectivity.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may create a safety hazard for pedestrians at night due to poor visibility and perceived lack of security.

hazards.name: Isolated walkway
hazards.description: The lack of active building frontage or 'eyes on the street' due to the large green space may reduce the sense of personal security for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the conflict zone without a mid-point refuge.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and multiple travel lanes suggest a high-speed environment which increases the severity of potential collisions.

hazards.name: High vehicle speeds

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry

hazards.name: Unprotected bike lane

hazards.name: Blank frontage

hazards.name: Railroad Crossing

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement lane narrowing or speed limit enforcement to reduce vehicle speeds on this arterial.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Furniture
interventions.description: Add benches or other amenities along the wide sidewalk to encourage activity and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk along the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian countdown signals at the nearby intersection to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width or number of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and provide space for a protected bike lane or wider sidewalk buffer.
